title: GRAIN level
changes: GRAIN output raised by another 2 dB; total +5 dB over the original V58 level.

title: GRAIN routing and preset initialization
changes: GRAIN cannot be saved or loaded as Bass, including stale USER/settings references.
Init preset is available in the SAVE action picker and the HOME collection menu.

title: GRAIN, closer to hand
changes: GRAIN is the second engine in the browser, immediately after Prophet.
SOURCE A/B preset selection advances one preset per encoder detent, with or without FINE.

title: Memory margin restored
changes: Preset and graphics caches use available ordinary RAM, restoring the required 8 KiB of POOL headroom.
All 64 USER presets, 30 loop slots and full GRAIN audio buffers are retained.

title: Meet the two sides of GRAIN
changes: Actual A/B buffer waveforms, source engine and preset names, generation status, Position cursor and blend display.
Factory-preset capture from Prophet, FM6, SWARM, CLUSTER, CLOUD, VA, FM TONE, PHASE and BASS, plus eight Original source families.
GRAINS and TEXTURE pages separate playback controls; SOURCE A/B occupy the former FILTER section.
GRAIN's filter DSP and filter modulation destinations. Existing filter settings no longer colour GRAIN patches.
Smaller graphics buffers and lossless glyph-cache packing reduce POOL use while preserving tested pixels.

title: A simpler engine list
changes: DRIFT and WAVE TERRAIN, including their Morph source choices. Stored engine IDs remain reserved.
Opening SAVE dismisses the temporary message that could cover Init preset.

title: GRAIN joins more chords!
changes: Two generated audio source buffers for GRAIN, with parameters saved in USER presets; the initial native sources were Prophet and FM6.
64 compatible FM6 factory sounds imported from the selected FM1 SysEx bank.
VA uses four chord voices on CPU0 and two on CPU1. Bass follows note velocity during legato changes.
TINES, VECTOR and CZ-1. Their stored IDs remain reserved.

title: More musical randomization
changes: Preset randomization focuses on timbre and avoids disruptive pitch changes while protecting native LFO and modulation settings.
Clearer Init preset access in SAVE and a smoother VA note start.
